INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

7. When practising Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Expressing Personal Opinions: Direct Object and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Information: Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 8.3.1 Functional Writing: Formal Letter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
